summary_1line: Bhishma recounts the divine origin of Kapila cows from Daksha and Surabhi, explaining their sacred status and why gifting them brings exceptional religious merit.

image_candidates.scene_text: From Daksha’s fragrant breath emerges the celestial cow Surabhi, glowing golden as the first mother of countless kine.
Mahadeva, seated upon the earth, opens his blazing third eye and its radiance streaks the herd of cows with many colors.
King Yudhishthira and his brothers present vast herds of bulls and cows as gifts to gathered Brahmanas during grand sacrifices.
